title: Elvin Jones and strong bass players
summary: Elvin needed strong bassists who matched his intensity.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Was the difference in bass players — make a difference in your playing when you were with Elvin?

Yeah. Because the bass player a lot of times, you would rely on the bass player to kind of give you the steady four, where Elvin would kind of maybe — playing loosey goosey around it. Strong bass players — you know Elvin relied on a strong bass player. He didn’t like a bass player that played the amp over the sound of the string — you know the percussiveness of the string. You know if he was putting this much intensity into the ride cymbal, and the bass player was just doing this because he’s allowing it, there’s a mismatch of energy that isn’t there. And he would feel it. So he would get really upset at
that. He didn’t have many of those guys. All the guys that I played with, from when I first went on, were all strong bass players.
